draft.subject: Getting Orchard Studio's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks again for the kickoff call last week. You mentioned nothing specific afterward, so I wanted to check in before the week gets away from us.

Two things tend to unlock Wrenfield quickly: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd rather do it solo.

Would a 20-minute call this week work? I'll help you stand up that first project live, and you can leave with it done.

Best,
Nadia
